long_biography.plain_text:
GFKL Financial Services became the company through which Peter Jänsch made his defining entrepreneurial mark. At 23, he established Procar before creating the leasing business that grew into GFKL. He expanded GFKL into debt collection and credit services, led it for nearly two decades and sold the company in 2009. In parallel, he co-founded con|energy to advise utilities navigating a changing energy market.

Jänsch now directs JVV, an Essen family office. Its core portfolio combines residential and commercial property with automotive dealerships and energy businesses, alongside technology and maritime investments. The group manages and develops its properties in-house. Jänsch also remains a managing director of BOB Automotive Group.
